title: A running EmDash base site wears the design system it is given: switching writes one slot file, the page matches the system's profile by role within seconds with no rebuild and no model turn, every text reads at 4.5:1, and with no slot the page computes exactly what it did before
steps: S1: node --test packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/test/slot.test.mjs, and in packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base tests/ds-slot.test.mjs + tests/ds-slot-template.test.mjs.
S2: node packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/audit.mjs (every Refero and OpenDesign system through normalise → gate → emit).

S3: build packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base from this tree (pnpm install if needed, pnpm build); serve dist/server/entry.mjs on 127.0.0.1:4391 with SITE_DATA_DIR = a new empty folder; seed with tools/bootstrap-site.sh. Snap the page with no system (flow-emdash.mjs --snap), then run packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/flow-emdash.mjs --baseline <snap> over the 11 pilot ids listed in the script (8 Refero incl. arte*, 3 OpenDesign).
Cleanup: the script kills the server it started and removes its data folder.
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped.
S2: the audit prints 'invariants: all hold' and exits 0.

S3: 10 systems × 2 widths judged; each matches its profile on every applicable measurement (match 1); each matches its own system ≥ 0.25 better than any other; every text kind on the page ≥ 4.5:1; no sideways scroll; served within 5 s of the call; the four no-system controls (before and after clearing, 1440 and 390) show 0 differences; arte* alone is refused (contrast-fg-bg).

S4: 44 page loads all 200 without sideways scroll; ?theme and the OS preference never flip a worn system and its toggle is hidden; with no system ?theme=dark still darkens and the toggle shows; the admin carries no slot and is byte-identical.

selectors.injected: <style id="tracy-ds-slot" data-ds="<profile id>"> and <html data-ds-worn> in src/layouts/Base.astro

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-slot-2026-10-09/README.md — the run on 09/10/2026 with every screenshot; plan tasks/ke-hoach-site-mac-dung-design-system.md.
fence: Mechanism only: the profile, the slot file, the template's fallbacks and what the page computes. Not covered: WordPress and Joomla (no slot yet), a fleet site (no build door writes the slot yet), and whether a person judges the result faithful to the source site — the screenshots are there for that.
